# app/controllers/api/v1/webhooks_controller.rb
class Api::V1::WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_api_key!

  # POST /api/v1/webhooks/validate
  # Validates that a webhook endpoint is reachable before saving
  def validate
    url = params[:callback_url]

    unless url.present?
      return render json: { error: 'callback_url is required' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    # Basic protocol check
    unless url.match?(/\Ahttps?:\/\//i)
      return render json: { error: 'Only HTTP(S) URLs are supported' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end

    # Resolve and validate the endpoint
    begin
      uri = URI.parse(url)
      
      # Block obviously internal hostnames
      blocked_hosts = %w[localhost 127.0.0.1 ::1 0.0.0.0]
      if blocked_hosts.include?(uri.host&.downcase)
        return render json: { error: 'Internal addresses are not allowed' }, status: :forbidden
      end

      # Perform validation request
      response = perform_health_check(uri)
      
      if response.code.to_i.between?(200, 299)
        render json: { status: 'reachable', response_code: response.code }
      else
        render json: { status: 'unreachable', response_code: response.code }, status: :bad_gateway
      end
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError => e
      render json: { error: "Invalid URL: #{e.message}" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    rescue StandardError => e
      render json: { error: "Connection failed: #{e.message}" }, status: :bad_gateway
    end
  end

  # POST /api/v1/webhooks
  def create
    webhook = current_account.webhooks.build(webhook_params)
    if webhook.save
      render json: webhook, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: webhook.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def perform_health_check(uri)
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == 'https')
    http.open_timeout = 5
    http.read_timeout = 5
    # Follow redirects up to 3 times for validation
    request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri.request_uri)
    request['User-Agent'] = 'WebhookValidator/1.0'
    response = http.request(request)
    
    # Handle redirects
    redirect_count = 0
    while response.is_a?(Net::HTTPRedirection) && redirect_count < 3
      redirect_url = response['location']
      redirect_uri = URI.parse(redirect_url)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(redirect_uri.host, redirect_uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = (redirect_uri.scheme == 'https')
      request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(redirect_uri.request_uri)
      request['User-Agent'] = 'WebhookValidator/1.0'
      response = http.request(request)
      redirect_count += 1
    end
    
    response
  end

  def webhook_params
    params.require(:webhook).permit(:callback_url, :event_type, :secret)
  end

  def authenticate_api_key!
    api_key = request.headers['X-Api-Key']
    unless api_key && ApiKey.active.exists?(key: api_key)
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  def current_account
    @current_account ||= ApiKey.find_by(key: request.headers['X-Api-Key']).account
  end
end
